title: Skill CLI Script Single-File Self-Containment and Language Server Isolation

claims.assertion: Helper scripts located under .agents/skills/<name>/scripts/ must remain self-contained single-file utilities to eliminate language server / Pyright module lookup errors outside project root src/.
claims.evidence: Splitting deepen_cycle.py into sibling deepen_ops.py caused Pyright 'Cannot find module' diagnostics. Consolidating into 189-line deepen_cycle.py in commit 6e43ba7 eliminated all errors.

claims.assertion: Self-contained skill CLI helpers can achieve multi-command orchestration (scan, check-lines, verify, push) within the strict <= 200 LOC bound (Rule 11) using compact argument dispatch.
claims.evidence: deepen_cycle.py orchestrates 4 subcommands across 189 lines while passing all contract tests.
